summary.text: In Otaria, Kamahl and the Cabal, in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma, who spreads Ixidor's message and effectively founds a religion around him.

Fugitives from the defeated army settle an abandoned city under Zagorka and Stonebrow, naming it Sanctum, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal, whose Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
In the final battle Phage, Akroma and Zagorka merge to form Karona, and when Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower, the goddess Karona is born.
